title: A new user creates a first Realm and preserves message continuity
intent: Exercise the shortest complete product path from first registration through recovery readiness, ordinary Realm bootstrap, message authoring, offline retry, reload, and a fresh sign-in without using hidden mutation APIs.

checkpoints.goal: Verify the single-site stack exposes one principal server and one Inkson origin with a writable isolated run state.
Register through the visible account flow, confirm the Recovery Key through sensitive input handling, and reach the product Ready state.
Reload during the first authenticated session and verify that onboarding resumes the same identity instead of creating another principal or returning to an unfinished registration step.
Create a private encrypted collaboration Realm named for the run with joined history and open its main discussion from normal navigation.
Publish an initial message, then add a reply, an edit, and a reaction through the visible conversation controls.
Take the browser offline, attempt one uniquely tagged message, restore connectivity, and wait for the product to reconcile it.
Reload the Realm after recovery and verify that the main discussion, authored content, edit, reaction, and reconciled message remain available.
Sign out and sign in again through the visible UI, then find the existing Realm without a direct URL and verify its history.
Use read-only evidence to confirm that the UI actions produced one principal, one Realm coordinate, creator membership, and one accepted copy of every uniquely tagged message.
